faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIT Roorkee is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech./ B.E. degree in specific engineering disciplines such as Electronics and Communication, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or Physics Engineering, along with a minimum CGPA of 7.0/10 or 70% and a valid GATE scorecard.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA as per norms.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the IIT Roorkee JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all required documents and send it to the official email address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial application screening followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 247667.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position, meaning it is not a permanent government job.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.
